<noinclude><pagequality level="3" user="Sp1nd01" /></noinclude>conceiued and bare †{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=† ''Heb. Chanoch.''}} Enoch and hee builded a City, and called the name of the City, after the name of his ſonne, Enoch.

{{Verse|4|18}} And vnto Enoch was borne Irad: and Irad begate Mehuiael, and Mehuiael begate Methuſael, and Methuſael begate †{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=† ''Hebr. Lemech.''}} Lamech.

{{Verse|4|19}} ¶ And Lamech tooke vnto him two wiues: the name of the one {{smaller|was}} Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

{{Verse|4|20}} And Adah bare Iabal: he was the father of ſuch as dwell in tents, and {{smaller|of ſuch as haue}} cattell.

{{Verse|4|21}} And his brothers name {{smaller|was}} Iubal: hee was the father of all ſuch as handle the harpe and organ.

{{Verse|4|22}} And Zillah, ſhe alſo bare Tubal-Cain, an †{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=† ''Heb. whetter.''}} inſtructer of euery artificer in braſſe and iron: and the ſiſter of Tubal-Cain {{smaller|was}} Naamah.

{{Verse|4|23}} And Lamech ſayd vnto his wiues, Adah and Zillah, Heare my voyce, yee wiues of Lamech, hearken vnto my ſpeech: for ǁ{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=ǁ Or, ''I would ſlay a man in my wound, &c.''}} I haue ſlaine a man to my wounding, and a yong man to my ǁ{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=ǁ''Or, in my hurt.''}} hurt.

{{Verse|4|24}} If Cain ſhall bee auenged ſeuen fold, truely Lamech ſeuenty and ſeuen folde.

{{Verse|4|25}} ¶ And Adam knew his wife againe, and ſhe bare a ſonne, ⁊ called his name †{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=† ''Hebr. Sheth.''}} Seth: For God, {{smaller|ſaid ſhe,}} hath appointed mee another ſeed in ſtead of Abel, whom Cain ſlew.

{{Verse|4|26}} And to Seth, to him alſo there was borne a ſonne, and he called his name †{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=† ''Hebr. Enoſh.''}} Enos: then began men to ǁ{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=ǁ''Or, to call'' themſelues ''by the Name of the'' {{small-caps|Lord}}.}} call vpon the Name of the LORD.

==={{Chapter|5|CHAP. V.}}===

{{smaller block|[[#5:1|1]] The genealogie, age, and death of the Patriarchs from Adam vnto Noah. [[#5:24|24]] The godlineſſe and tranſlation of Enoch.}}

{{Verse|5|1|notext=}} {{dropinitial|T|image=King James Bible (1611) page A1v (T).xcf|imgsize=100px}}His ''is'' the *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=* 1. Chron. 1. 1.}} booke of the generations of Adam: In the day that God created man, in the likenes of God made he him.

{{Verse|5|2}} *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=* Wiſd. 2. 23.}} Male and female created hee them, and bleſſed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

{{Verse|5|3}} ¶ And Adam liued an hundred and thirtie yeeres, and begate {{smaller|a ſonne}} in his owne likeneſſe, after his image; and called his name Seth.

{{Verse|5|4}} *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=* 1. Chron. 1. 1. &c.}} And the dayes of Adam, after he had begotten Seth, were eight hundred yeeres: and he begate ſonnes and daughters.

{{Verse|5|5}} And all the dayes that Adam liued, were nine hundred and thirtie yeeres: and he died.

{{Verse|5|6}} And Seth liued an hundred and fiue yeeres: and begate †{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=† ''Hebr. Enoſh.''}} Enos.

{{Verse|5|7}} And Seth liued, after he begate Enos, eight hundred and ſeuen yeeres, and begate ſonnes and daughters.

{{Verse|5|8}} And all the dayes of Seth, were nine hundred and twelue yeeres, and he died.

{{Verse|5|9}} ¶ And Enos liued ninetie yeeres, and begate †{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=† ''Heb. Kenan.''}} Cainan.

{{Verse|5|10}} And Enos liued after hee begate Cainan, eight hundred and fifteene yeeres, and begate ſonnes ⁊ daughters.

{{Verse|5|11}} And all the dayes of Enos were nine hundred ⁊ fiue yeres; and he died.

{{Verse|5|12}} ¶ And Cainan liued ſeuentie yeeres, and begate †{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=† ''Greeke, Maleleel.''}} Mahalaleel.

{{Verse|5|13}} And Cainan liued after he begate Mahalaleel, eight hundred and fourtie yeeres, ⁊ begate ſonnes and daughters.

{{Verse|5|14}} And al the dayes of Cainan were nine hundred ⁊ ten yeres; and he died.

{{Verse|5|15}} ¶ And Mahalaleel liued ſixtie and fiue yeeres, and begat †{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=† ''Heb, Iered.''}} Iared.

{{Verse|5|16}} And Mahalaleel liued after he begate Iared, eight hundred and thirtie yeeres, and begate ſonnes ⁊ daughters.

{{Verse|5|17}} And all the dayes of Mahalaleel, were eight hundred ninetie and fiue yeeres, and he died.

{{Verse|5|18}} ¶ And Iared liued an hundred ſixtie and two yeeres, ⁊ he begat Enoch.

{{Verse|5|19}} And Iared liued after he begate Enoch, eight hundred yeres, and begate ſonnes and daughters.

{{Verse|5|20}} And all the dayes of Iared were nine hundred ſixtie and two yeeres, and he died.

{{Verse|5|21}} ¶ And Enoch liued ſixtie and fiue yeeres, and begate ǁ{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=ǁ''Gr. Mathuſala.''}} Methuſelah.

{{Verse|5|22}} And Enoch walked with God, after he begate Methuſelah, three hundred yeeres, and begate ſonnes and daughters.

{{Verse|5|23}} And all the dayes of Enoch, were three hundred ſixtie and fiue yeeres.

{{Verse|5|24}} And *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=* Ecclus. 44. 16. heb. 11. 5.}} Enoch walked with God: and he {{smaller|was}} not; for God tooke him.

{{Verse|5|25}} And Methuſelah liued an hundred eightie and ſeuen yeeres, and begat Lamech.

{{Verse|5|26}} And Methuſelah liued, after hee begate †{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=† ''Hebr. Lemech.''}} Lamech, ſeuen hundred, eightie<noinclude></noinclude>
